controller.control_channel: Docker stdin remains open for the adapter lifetime
controller.control_loss_action: PID 1 terminates the direct child and exits
controller.kernel_boundary: Linux removes all remaining processes in a PID namespace when PID 1 exits

required_probe.attack: the adapter fixture creates a new session and process group, then the host Docker client is killed without graceful cleanup
required_probe.success: the labeled container disappears and the escaped descendant heartbeat stops
required_probe.binding: report hashes the Docker executable/identity, image digest, in-image controller bytes, and exact run command

provider_client_image_candidate.base: the exact cache-complete checker image built from the common pre-audit workspace
provider_client_image_candidate.source_lock: the native Linux Codex registry package is version-, URL-, SRI-, and SHA-512-locked, then reduced to four regular allowlisted members before Docker sees it
provider_client_image_candidate.contents: the inherited offline Lean toolchain/cache, exact Codex executable/bundled bwrap/rg, the target-drift adapter, and the PID-1 controller
provider_client_image_candidate.host_user_namespace_boundary: Docker applies the hash-bound abrl-target-drift-codex AppArmor profile to the entire non-root agent-container process tree. Its sole AppArmor rule grants userns so the trusted native Codex client can launch its nested bubblewrap user, PID, and network namespaces; it supplies no Linux capability, while Docker still enforces its read-only root, capability drop, no-new-privileges, resource, and outer-network boundaries
required_result_free_probes: in-image Codex/Lean/Lake/cache/controller/adapter bytes match their build ledgers

the evaluated child reports the exact abrl-target-drift-codex AppArmor profile inherited by the non-root agent-container process tree before any workspace, network, or credential observation is accepted

the evaluated command can write its workspace, cannot persist a write outside it, receives an explicit IPv4 route denial to the same endpoint reached by the outer control, and cannot read the outer credential sentinel
the exact final candidate digest passes host-control-loss PID-namespace reaping
provider_client_image_candidate.credential_boundary: the candidate build and probes contain no provider credential and make no model call

production_gate: replace the result-free probe with a sealed outer launcher that gives the adapter root-only control state and the evaluated Codex child a non-root tmpfs workspace
mount one provider credential through the frozen credential boundary without exposing it to model-spawned commands
freeze the exact provider/model/settings/prices/budgets and publish the final image digest plus all final-image probes
pass the permanently result-ineligible one-case-by-three-condition real-infrastructure smoke before any primary run
production_nonclaims: A lifecycle candidate does not freeze the final provider-capable agent image.
Network, filesystem, auth, provider-client, toolchain, and budget isolation require their own final-image probes and attestations.
No lifecycle probe is a model run or formalization outcome.
